ours.name: flutter3d_audio_core
ours.description: Positional audio for flutter3d without a backend: attenuation, panning, occlusion, voice limiting and the mixer's buses.

ours.name: flutter3d_camera
ours.description: Virtual cameras for flutter3d games: priorities and blends, framing by targets with dead zones and damping, group shots, keeping clear of walls, and shake seeded by the step.

ours.name: flutter3d_effects
ours.description: The elements' water and fire, drawn: a lit water surface, a waterfall with its spray, bubbles and froth, flames, smoke, embers and firelight, and a liquid in a vessel.

ours.name: flutter3d_elements
ours.description: Water, fire and bodies in a world of the physics core's, stepped with no renderer: flames held to bodies, waters poured and fed, plugin elements over the world's fields, and their events.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_kit
ours.description: Gameplay parts for flutter3d games, one library each: reactions, a soundtrack, ghosts of past runs, seeded levels and the world past the simulated square.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_platformer
ours.description: A second genre: a runner who jumps twice and dashes, things to collect, hazards to fall into, and checkpoints to come back at.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_racing
ours.description: A third genre: a car with grip it can lose, a track measured in metres, and the lap that comes of going round it.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_shooter
ours.description: The parts of a first-person shooter that are not parts of an engine: monsters, weapons, an inventory, and the step order that ties them together.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_strategy
ours.description: A fourth genre: ground made of samples, units that move as a crowd rather than one at a time, and orders given to a selection instead of to a body.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_ui
ours.description: Every widget around a flutter3d game, one library each: HUD and maps, touch controls, settings, accessibility, title and credits screens, photo mode, sharing a run.

ours.name: flutter3d_plugin_runtime
ours.description: Plugins loaded while a game runs: data plugins read from a .f3dplugin document, and sandboxed Wasm modules on a deterministic interpreter, held to the permissions granted.

ours.name: flutter3d_post
ours.description: Post-processing for flutter3d, one library per family: light, shading, reflections, atmosphere, motion and style, and a standard preset of all six. Each effect is a plugin.
